source: Reproduces the constants of R10_PREREGISTRATION_H2EVAL_R3_2 (sha256 57698f34a1d9699348b3330cab067c130d32a5bdb7857b7965ab7612e0eae6c6) as they were hard-coded in plan.ts / contract_r2.ts at executor d2c60a98: 256 output tokens for every task; Haiku 5.5 adaptive thinking effort low with a 1024-token reasoning allowance; Haiku 4.5 without thinking; GPT-4o mini without reasoning; Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite thinkingLevel minimal with a 2048-token allowance. NOT the R4 design: R4_DESIGN_PARAMS.json (ECON-02, runs/B1/R4) replaces this file when ratified.
notes: A plan built with this file has the same request bodies as the R17 pilot (effort low, max_tokens 256) and therefore reproduces the S1 truncation observed on 2026-11-11.
The protocolHash of a plan includes the sha256 of this file.
